title: Returned my old part but still no replacement after 15+ days! Terrible service.
body: WaterScience’s post-sales customer service and warranty support are completely unreliable. My unit developed an issue despite having a 2-year warranty. I fulfilled my end of the process by returning the old, damaged housing to them, but it has been over 15 days and I am still waiting for the replacement to arrive. Customer support keeps sending generic excuses about "operational issues" and vague dispatch timelines while my product remains unusable. It is completely unacceptable to leave a customer stranded for weeks after taking back the old part. A 2-year warranty means nothing if the company fails on basic fulfillment. Very disappointing experience—think twice before buying Update: Even the replacement is faulty. Do not buy this product

title: Dont buy unless inlet is made more sturdy
body: The plastic inlet broke under water pressure after just three days of use (photo provided), making the product unusable. I highly recommend using higher-quality, durable materials for this component. Because it broke so quickly, I cannot comment on its filtration performance. Installation was easy that is the only plus point in this product. Compared to this RiverSoft SF-15 PRO is much better prodict. I would recommend to go for that.

title: Doesn't work for me
body: I don't see any noticeable change in the water after putting this water filter. Fill-up a bucket of water keep it overnight, I see a surface layer (off white, possibly mineral). Even after I put the filter I can see the same. I bought the filter particularly because my hairs become kind of sticky after taking a shower with the bore-well water. But the problem remains same after using the filter too. The red indicator stripe is at the middle after using only for couple of days. I am using bore-well water at Hyderabad. Possibly, the filter makes good water little bit more better. But not at all worthy for very hard bore-well water. I am using it for a couple of weeks now. Looking at it's performance, I do not recommend to buy it, especially with paying a too high price. One can go for a low cost filter to try first.
